CAPTURED DEFECT / INPUT: Input is broken in multiple scenes. Start with `Assets/Scenes/SmallVoxelShowcase.unity` and prove the root cause there before widening the fix. Current master is configured for the Input System package, but the `VoxelEngine.Showcase.VoxelShowcase` runtime used by SmallVoxelShowcase still reads `UnityEngine.Input` directly. The observed runtime failure is: `InvalidOperationException: You are trying to read Input using the UnityEngine.Input class, but you have switched active Input handling to Input System package in Player Settings`, thrown from `UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown`, then `VoxelEngine.Showcase.VoxelShowcase.HandleKeys()` at `Assets/Game/Composition/Showcase/SceneRuntime/VoxelShowcase.cs:782`, then `VoxelShowcase.Update()` at line 443. Current `VoxelShowcase` also uses legacy `Input.GetKey`, `Input.GetAxisRaw`, scroll-axis reads, and `Input.ResetInputAxes`, so the correction must cover the complete interactive path rather than only the first crashing key read.

A second exception occurs before/around PlayMode scene startup in the Structures test harness: `NullReferenceException` inside `UnityEngine.Rendering.DebugManager.set_displayPersistentRuntimeUI`, reached through `DebugUpdater.DisableRuntime`, `DebugManager.set_enableRuntimeUI`, reflection `PropertyInfo.SetValue`, and `VoxelEngine.Structures.Tests.PlayMode.RenderDebugUiTestBootstrap.Disable()` in `Assets/VoxelEngine/Structures/Tests/PlayMode/TypedStructuralSocketCompositionSceneTests.cs`. Treat this as a separate captured symptom until evidence proves the same owner. The harness must not throw while trying to suppress SRP debug input; fixing or removing that bootstrap must not hide the production input failure.

SCOPE / ARCHITECTURE: First reproduce SmallVoxelShowcase under the repository's actual Input-System-only player settings. Determine the shared input ownership boundary and migrate the production interaction path to the supported Input System API or an existing reusable semantic input adapter. Do not enable legacy/both input handling globally as a workaround. Do not add scene-local key polling shims. After proving the SmallVoxelShowcase cause, enumerate other player-visible scenes/runtimes that consume the same broken legacy-input/shared runtime path and fix those consumers through the same reusable boundary. If another scene is broken for a materially independent owner, record it separately rather than expanding this issue speculatively. The newer `HouseShowcase` already demonstrates direct `UnityEngine.InputSystem` keyboard/mouse handling on current master and may be used as a compatibility reference, not copied blindly.

ACCEPTANCE: (1) SmallVoxelShowcase starts and remains interactive without the captured legacy Input `InvalidOperationException`; (2) normal keyboard/mouse behavior still works through the supported Input System path, including movement, look, cursor lock/unlock, sprint/jump/fly controls, interaction/respawn keys, scrolling/brush control, and edit actions that are actually supported by this scene; (3) focus loss/regain and cursor recapture remain correct without legacy `Input.ResetInputAxes`; (4) the responsible shared runtime no longer performs forbidden `UnityEngine.Input` reads when Player Settings are Input-System-only; (5) other scenes proven to consume that same broken shared path are migrated and regression-checked; (6) the `RenderDebugUiTestBootstrap` startup path no longer throws the captured SRP DebugManager null-reference and does not suppress or mask production exceptions; (7) add focused module-owned behavioral validation using the real production input/runtime path, plus built-player validation of SmallVoxelShowcase; and (8) built-player evidence demonstrates actual user input changing camera/player state, not merely a scene launch with no exceptions. Follow `AGENTS.md`, `SceneIssues/README.md`, and `SceneIssues/issue-readme.md`; keep the issue open until every captured symptom assigned to this shared owner is resolved and validated.
